import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;

    static int addMod(int x, int y) {
        x += y;
        if (x >= MOD) x -= MOD;
        return x;
    }

    static long mulMod(long x, long y) {
        return (x * y) % MOD;
    }

    static class Matrix {
        int[][] m;
        int rows;
        int cols;

        Matrix(int rows, int cols) {
            this.rows = rows;
            this.cols = cols;
            this.m = new int[rows][cols];
        }

        void zero() {
            for (int i = 0; i < rows; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < cols; j++) {
                    m[i][j] = 0;
                }
            }
        }

        void unit() {
            zero();
            int minDim = Math.min(rows, cols);
            for (int i = 0; i < minDim; i++) {
                m[i][i] = 1;
            }
        }

        static Matrix mul(Matrix a, Matrix b) {
            Matrix res = new Matrix(a.rows, b.cols);
            res.zero();
            for (int i = 0; i < a.rows; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < a.cols; j++) {
                    if (a.m[i][j] != 0) {
                        for (int k = 0; k < b.cols; k++) {
                            res.m[i][k] = addMod(res.m[i][k], (int) mulMod(a.m[i][j], b.m[j][k]));
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            return res;
        }

        Matrix add(Matrix other) {
            Matrix res = new Matrix(this.rows, this.cols);
            for (int i = 0; i < rows; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < cols; j++) {
                    res.m[i][j] = addMod(this.m[i][j], other.m[i][j]);
                }
            }
            return res;
        }

        Matrix mul(int scalar) {
            Matrix res = new Matrix(this.rows, this.cols);
            for (int i = 0; i < rows; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < cols; j++) {
                    res.m[i][j] = (int) mulMod(this.m[i][j], scalar);
                }
            }
            return res;
        }

        int[] getRow(int idx) {
            return m[idx];
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        
        long n = sc.nextLong();
        int K = sc.nextInt();
        
        List<Integer> digits = new ArrayList<>();
        
        Matrix[][] A = new Matrix[65][35];
        Matrix[][] S = new Matrix[65][35];
        Matrix[][] P = new Matrix[65][35];
        Matrix result = new Matrix(35, 35);
        
        for (int i = 0; i < 65; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < 35; j++) {
                A[i][j] = new Matrix(35, 35);
                S[i][j] = new Matrix(35, 35);
                P[i][j] = new Matrix(35, 35);
            }
        }
        
        result.unit();
        
        for (int i = 0; i < K; i++) {
            A[0][i].unit();
            for (int j = 0; j <= K; j++) {
                A[0][i].m[i][j] = 1;
            }
        }
        
        long blockLen = K;
        for (int level = 1; blockLen <= n; ++level, blockLen *= K) {
            S[level - 1][K - 1] = new Matrix(35, 35);
            for (int i = 0; i < 35; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < 35; j++) {
                    S[level - 1][K - 1].m[i][j] = A[level - 1][K - 1].m[i][j];
                }
            }
            
            for (int j = K - 2; j >= 0; --j) {
                S[level - 1][j] = Matrix.mul(A[level - 1][j], S[level - 1][j + 1]);
            }
            
            P[level - 1][0] = new Matrix(35, 35);
            for (int i = 0; i < 35; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < 35; j++) {
                    P[level - 1][0].m[i][j] = A[level - 1][0].m[i][j];
                }
            }
            
            for (int j = 1; j < K; ++j) {
                P[level - 1][j] = Matrix.mul(P[level - 1][j - 1], A[level - 1][j]);
            }
            
            A[level][0] = new Matrix(35, 35);
            for (int i = 0; i < 35; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < 35; j++) {
                    A[level][0].m[i][j] = S[level - 1][0].m[i][j];
                }
            }
            
            for (int j = 1; j < K; ++j) {
                A[level][j] = Matrix.mul(S[level - 1][j], P[level - 1][j - 1]);
            }
        }
        
        long tempN = n;
        while (tempN > 0) {
            digits.add((int) (tempN % K));
            tempN /= K;
        }
        
        int offset = 0;
        for (int i = digits.size() - 1; i >= 0; --i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < digits.get(i); ++j) {
                result = Matrix.mul(result, A[i][(j + offset) % K]);
            }
            offset = (offset + digits.get(i)) % K;
        }
        
        int answer = 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < K; ++i) {
            answer = addMod(answer, result.m[i][K]);
        }
        System.out.println(answer);
    }
}
